player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

round.announce:
### Raundi {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Kadi ya mpinzani wako ni: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Peleka kitendo kimoja kilichowekwa mabano, kwa mfano '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', au '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Cannot [check] - you are facing a bet.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Palije ico mungacita; mungatumira [check] m'malo mwake.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Use [bet X] to open; there is no bet to raise.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: wote {card}. Pot imegawanywa – kila mmoja anapata {split}.

outcome.draw: Chips zofanana pambuyo pa ma round onse.
